run1.outcome: 27 checks passed, then a TimeoutError in step 8 before walkthrough.json was written: after 'Show the 0 candidates' the script waited for a rearrangement row or an error, but PRIVTEST has no junction under the page's defaults (translocations only), and the page shows 'No junction passes these filters' (an .empty box). The two cloud questions were sent in this run; their meta lines (time, turns, tokens, cost) were drawn below the screenshots' viewport and were not recorded, and the server keeps no copy. The answers are in screenshots run1_08 and run1_09.
